# OpenAPI fixtures

Unmodified copies of public examples from the OpenAPI Initiative's
[learn.openapis.org](https://github.com/OAI/learn.openapis.org) repository
(`examples/`), used only to test the parser:

| File                     | Source path                            | OpenAPI |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `petstore-expanded.yaml` | `examples/v3.0/petstore-expanded.yaml` | 3.0     |
| `api-with-examples.json` | `examples/v3.0/api-with-examples.json` | 3.0     |
| `tictactoe.yaml`         | `examples/v3.1/tictactoe.yaml`         | 3.1     |
| `webhook-example.yaml`   | `examples/v3.1/webhook-example.yaml`   | 3.1     |
